name: Strawberry Ice Cream I
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Wash and hull berries, sprinkle with sugar, cover, and let stand two hours.
Mash, and squeeze through cheese-cloth; then add salt.
Freeze cream to the consistency of a mush, add gradually fruit juice, and finish freezing.
Rich Jersey milk may be substituted for cream.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
